options.label: AUTO priority
options.summary: OpenVINO tries your devices in order and runs the model on the first one that can compile it. It uses one device at a time.

chat.reason: OpenVINO picks the first listed device that can compile the model. It does not use several devices at once.

options.label: AUTO cumulative throughput
options.summary: Loads a copy of the model on every listed device and spreads requests across them. It helps many parallel requests, rarely a single chat.

chat.reason: Runs copies of the model on every listed device for throughput. InferBridge serves one request at a time per model, so single chats rarely get faster. Mixed CPU and GPU execution also makes GenAI fall back from paged attention.

options.label: HETERO
options.summary: Splits the model's layers across the devices: the first device runs what it supports and the next one takes the rest.

chat.reason: Splits the model's layers across devices. Useful when a model does not fit in GPU memory (turn on pipeline-parallel); otherwise usually slower than the GPU alone.

vlm.reason: Splits the model's layers across devices. Useful when a model does not fit in GPU memory (turn on pipeline-parallel); otherwise usually slower than the GPU alone.

embedding.reason: Splits the model's layers across devices; rarely faster for small models.

rerank.reason: Splits the model's layers across devices; rarely faster for small models.

options.label: HETERO pipeline-parallel
options.summary: Splits a model that is too large for the first device's memory into stages across the devices (an OpenVINO preview).

chat.reason: Splits the model's layers across devices. Useful when a model does not fit in GPU memory (turn on pipeline-parallel); otherwise usually slower than the GPU alone.
